# DiffWitness

> DiffWitness is a local-first runtime protection, executable proof, explanation and software-debt control layer for AI-generated code.

Canonical human pages:
- / — Product overview and audience routing
- /developers/ — Technical assurance, proof protocol, Protect, CI and Debt Ledger
- /builders/ — Guided plain-language experience for AI builders
- /manifesto/ — The 20th Prompt Problem
- /docs/ — Alpha quickstart and core reference
- /guides/ — Task-based workflows
- /pricing/ — Proposed commercial-alpha packaging
- /lab/ — Sphaira Lab and the conceptual complexity field

Agent-readable summaries:
- /llms-full.txt — Consolidated product and trust contract
- /developers.md — Technical product summary
- /builders.md — Guided product summary
- /docs.md — Quickstart and command index
- /manifesto.md — Manifesto summary
- /pricing.md — Proposed plan structure and commercial caveat

Authoritative implementation sources:
- https://github.com/TFourniax/tooltest
- https://github.com/TFourniax/tooltest/tree/rc/human-test-final-2026-09-01/docs

Core trust rule:
VERIFIED comes from an executed verification adapter for the bound change or obligation. OBSERVED, SUGGESTED and UNKNOWN must never be upgraded to VERIFIED by presentation code or an LLM.
